Class LoginScene

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.graphic.scenes.LoginScene
public class LoginScene extends Object
The LoginScene class is responsible for managing the login and setup screen for a multiplayer game

  • Method Details

    • createScene

      public javafx.scene.Scene createScene(boolean resume, List<String> nicknames, List<PlayerColors> colors)
      Creates a new scene for the login process based on the provided configuration
      Parameters:
      resume - a boolean value indicating whether to resume a game (true) or start a new game (false)
      nicknames - a list of player nicknames to be used when resuming a game
      colors - a list of player colors to be used when resuming a game
      Returns:
      a Scene object representing the generated scene for the login or game setup

    • createNewGameScene

      private javafx.scene.Scene createNewGameScene()
      Creates a new game scene where the user can input a nickname and select a player color
      Returns:
      a Scene object representing the new game setup screen

    • createResumeGameScene

      private javafx.scene.Scene createResumeGameScene(List<String> nicknames, List<PlayerColors> colors)
      Creates a new scene for resuming a game, where users can select their profiles based on provided nicknames and colors
      Parameters:
      nicknames - a list of player nicknames available for selection when resuming a game
      colors - a list of corresponding player colors associated with the nicknames
      Returns:
      a Scene object representing the generated UI for profile selection to resume the game
